evidence: The green HTTP candidate was gated and the model scored both items; run-progress passed and recorded the eleven required effects in order, including gate-attempt-passed and both score effects.
After R-1 failed at fence, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the run list contained R-1 once for C-1.
While R-1’s builder slept, starting R-2 returned run-in-progress; R-2 queried as null and R-1 remained running.
Grain recorded R-1 passed for C-1; starting R-2 for C-1 returned cycle-already-run and R-2 queried as null.
Started R-1 with the nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run returned -32000 not-a-commit, and run-progress returned null. No builder was configured or launched.
A fixture plan with no scenarios produced a refused checklist effect, empty-checklist; run-progress showed a halt at checklist before any self-check or fence.
A fixture with two stamped scenarios and one unstamped scenario recorded three stamp events and halted at stamp because identities differed; it recorded neither pin nor checklist.

The self-check exited 1 with golden checklist differs; run-progress showed a failed cycle at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail, with self-check the final effect and no fence or regenerate.
The passing self-check printed SKIP bb-tools; its first effect recorded harness-self-check-passed, with bb-tools listed among skipped checks and named in its detail.
With impl present and harness/cycles absent, fence was refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, then fail-cycle was recorded; the cycle failed at fence for fence-refused and no builder launched.
The builder recorded a clean room with the plan and configuration and one commit; its object listing held neither fenced path, and its candidate scope was empty.
A red first candidate and green repair caused two builder launches; the timeline recorded first start/end before second start/end with distinct session identities, and the cycle passed.
The builder exited 1 after writing a candidate; regenerate recorded its independently computed digest and the run passed its gate and cycle.
The builder exited 0 without writing the candidate; run-progress recorded fail-cycle without a regenerate effect and showed the cycle failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.
The 30-second builder was stopped by a 2-second regenerate budget; run-progress showed the cycle failed at regenerate for budget.
An already-answering HTTP server caused three seam-answered-before-boot refusals, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure and the launch marker was absent.
A red suite and one-attempt budget produced gate-attempt-failed for suite-red and a cycle failure for gate-attempts-exhausted; the launch-entrypoint marker was absent.
A candidate with executable test.sh and no start.sh produced a gate-attempt-failed event for contract-missing.
The green candidate served a page without sauna; its single gate attempt recorded gate-attempt-failed for identity-probe-failed.
After the builder exited, its background writer changed the original suite to exit 1; the installed copy passed the gate and the install and regenerate digests matched.
The repair recorded verification-repair and named attempt 1’s evidence root; its builder saw the clean room, previous candidate and gate evidence, and write probes to both mounts failed.
Each of three builder launches left a red suite; run-progress failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted, without file-verdicts, and the sole model request was render rather than an item researcher.
The researcher code branched on the item and failed for 01-002; file-verdicts included only 01-001, measurement marked 01-002 unreached, and the run passed with 1 of 2.
R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist; rereading each after five seconds showed the same status and identical effect results.
After the cycle passed, two run-progress queries returned identical run objects, both still passed.
A probe requiring exactly http://127.0.0.1:18901 and a page carrying sauna passed; the gate and cycle both passed.
The suite created and removed impl/temp in the gate room, then the HTTP candidate passed the gate; the install and regenerate digests matched.
The passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; its event listed the complete text after SKIP as the skipped check, and the effect detail retained the line.
The stdio suite, probe and store check passed; gate-attempt-passed recorded 30 seconds, one poll, answer on poll 1 and answered as the context. The cycle passed without a gate refusal.

The stdio probe recorded the gate-room start.sh absolute path and 30, and GATE_STORE under attempt evidence outside the gate room; its environment contained no LOYLY_ variables and the store check received the same path.
The stdio suite exited 1 and its gate attempt failed suite-red; its recorded environment had no GATE_STORE or LOYLY_ variable, and neither probe nor store check ran.
The stdio probe exited 1 with no response within the 30s boot budget; gate-attempt-failed recorded identity-probe-failed with that detail, and the store-check marker was absent.

The stdio suite and probe passed, then the store check exited 1 with FAIL event 7 was not written inside a run of the ORC workflow; gate-attempt-failed recorded identity-probe-failed with that detail.
A stdio suite requiring plan/01-test/spec.feature passed the gate; regenerate and install recorded the same candidate digest.
With stdio suite and probe passing and no store-check command, run-progress halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate effect.
Two stdio runs on the same store differed only in the store-check command argument; both first self-checks passed and their harness digests differed.
A plan symlink 01-a to ../spec/a recorded stamp events for both items, and checklist-derived named 01-001 and 01-002 under plan/01-a; the run did not halt.
With slices 01 and 02 present and PLAN_SLICES=02, the only stamp was slice 02 and the checklist contained only 02-001.
Both builder launches recorded three arguments including the configured image path; regenerate and repair named builder-clojure and its independently computed digest.
A valid commit named a builder image absent from the image directory; start-run returned -32000 builder-image-missing, run-progress returned null, and no builder was launched.
Two runs on one store passed; C-2’s scoreboard named previous cycle C-1, and R-2’s stamp recorded no new identities and did not halt.
The cut probe sourced harness/config.sh relative to itself and checked the served marker; the gate passed and install and regenerate recorded the same digest.

The gate command ran once from the project repository with the cut tree, independently verified candidate copy and empty evidence directory; the launch marker was absent. Gate-attempt-passed recorded 10 seconds, 20 polls, poll 3, and ledger answered as itself.
The first command-gate result recorded suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair builder read its evidence file on a read-only mount, and the second gate attempt passed.
The gate command returned seam-answered-before-boot three times; each refused gate effect was followed by gate-refusal, and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.
The gate command exited 2 with infrastructure the world did not come up; the run halted at gate for effect-could-not-run with that detail and no gate, fail-cycle, or cycle result.

Three runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b produced three distinct self-check harness digests. The no-command digest matched SHA-256 of the configuration bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.
The run passed; Grain event order placed each of its eleven effect results between the start and completion of the corresponding named leaf in the cycle tick or its delegated gate tick.
A server returning 503 for its first three requests passed on poll 5 of 20 with a 10-second budget; attempt 1 recorded boot margin 15 polls.
The second attempt passed. Grain placed each attempt’s install, self-check and gate in a separate gate-attempt.v1 child of the run tick, and repair attempt 2 inside attempt 1’s child tick.
A copy of the candidate launched from a temporary directory outside .pi and the project repository; its first gate attempt and cycle passed. The temporary directory was removed after profiling.
The judge scored 01-001 pass/booked and 01-002 fail/no receipt; measurement filed 1 of 2 and the run passed. Grain recorded each checklist-named score in a distinct grade.v1 child of the run tick.
The first item researcher produced E-ONE; the first judge request contained it, while neither the second researcher nor second judge request did.

The first researcher request included the scenario, fixture seam and event model. Its shell reported Linux, the item grading folder with clean-room files and candidate, and a parent containing only 01-001.
The second judge omitted reasoning; progress and Grain showed only the first score, file-verdicts offered only 01-001, and measurement filed 1 of 2 with 01-002 unreached.
With the computed sealed-grader digest absent from the approved list, run-progress halted at grader for refused-before-the-cycle and named the digest; no self-check, fence or builder occurred.

With every researcher request returning HTTP 400, file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts and fail-score-stage recorded; the cycle failed at score for score-stage-failed and the builder log contained only the initial launch.

The runner and first sleeping builder were killed after five seconds; on restart with the same store the run passed and the builder log showed the same session identity twice. Progress retained one stamp, pin, checklist, first self-check, fence and regenerate result each.
The builder’s first instruction file contained exactly INSTRUCTION-7; its repair instruction added only a closing paragraph naming the previous candidate and gate evidence paths.
The model returned HTTP 400 for render; run-progress halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate, fail-cycle, cycle, or builder launch.
While the builder slept, run-progress showed R-1 and its tick running, with fence and render completed and regenerate marked running as the last node.
